items.title: Stock Market LIVE: GIFT Nifty signals positive open; Asia markets fall; Brent crude extends loss
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Wednesday: The GIFT Nifty indicated a positive open for the Nifty50 index. Asian markets declined ahead of Nvidia Corp's earnings

items.title: Solar panel maker Avaada Electro files updated DRHP for ₹7,600 crore IPO
items.description: The Brookfield-backed company plans a ₹1,600 crore fresh issue and a ₹6,000 crore offer for sale as it expands solar module and cell manufacturing capacity in India

items.title: Purple Style Labs sets price band, eyes ₹4,604 crore IPO valuation
items.description: The company will raise up to ₹680 crore in a fresh issue to fund lease liabilities, marketing and expansion, with the offer opening on August 31 and closing on September 2
